mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_request (id, requester_id, addressee_id, user_low_id, user_high_id, request_message, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{requesterId}, #{addresseeId}, #{userLowId}, #{userHighId}, #{requestMessage}, #{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE requester_id = VALUES(requester_id), addressee_id = VALUES(addressee_id), request_message = VALUES(request_message), status = VALUES(status), handle_time = NULL, create_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, requester_id, addressee_id, user_low_id, user_high_id, request_message, status, handle_time, create_time, update_time FROM friend_request WHERE user_low_id = #{userLowId} AND user_high_id = #{userHighId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, requester_id, addressee_id, user_low_id, user_high_id, request_message, status, handle_time, create_time, update_time FROM friend_request WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, requester_id, addressee_id, user_low_id, user_high_id, request_message, status, handle_time, create_time, update_time FROM friend_request WHERE (requester_id = #{userId} OR addressee_id = #{userId}) AND status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
